metadata.division: DIVISION 4-7-1. PURPOSE AND APPLICATION OF ARTICLE

content.title: 4-7-1-2. Application of article.
content.summary: A.	Fences and Divisional Walls.Division 4-7-2, Fences and Divisional Walls, provides a set of standards and tables establish heights and materials for fences, divisional walls, and retaining walls.

faqs.a: A.	Fences and Divisional Walls.Division 4-7-2, Fences and Divisional Walls, provides a set of standards and tables establish heights and materials for fences, divisional walls, and retaining walls.
